_comment: EXAMPLE -- copy this file to report-pairs.json beside it and replace every placeholder path.
Ask-Report.ps1 reads report-pairs.json: which SERVER index and which SQL-script index belong with a CLIENT
project index, for the questions that read more than one (round-trip, lands-where: server + SQL;
consumers, feeds-from: SQL; crosses-boundary: the other side, optional). Without the file no pairs are
configured: those questions stop and say so, and every single-index question still works.
Take each path from the engine, never guess it:
sql     drag-lint resolve-dbs --in <one of the .SQL scripts>   (sqlSection = that index's manifest section)
sqlSection is used only to print the SQL index's reindex command when it is stale.
Add a project: one more object in pairs.
